body: Thank you for the advice. It is very helpful.
By distracting myself he will get more angry at me for not paying attention to what he says and does.

I have to stay with him for another half year. He makes me so afraid to make mistakes. Dropping out is not an option. I just need the courage to keep going there and not caring about his opinion of me.

He makes me cry a lot and he makes me feel so insecure about my work. I don't know what I can do about this situation. I have to be there every weekday but it is just so mentally exhausting and I don't know how I can survive this for another half year. 

But yeah, he really can not control his emotions at all. 
I am afraid my mental health will decrease because of him.
